semiconductor_relevance: High — All Ring Tech Co., Ltd. specializes in automation equipment for semiconductor manufacturing processes, particularly for passive components and ICs.
summary: All Ring Tech Co., Ltd. (ART) provides high-technology automation equipment tailored for production lines in the semiconductor industry. With a focus on design, assembly, and programming, ART supports manufacturers of passive components and integrated circuits with innovative solutions.
capabilities: Die Sorter and Pick & Place Systems

regional_presence.Taiwan: Headquartered in Kaohsiung Science Park, ART has a significant manufacturing presence in Taiwan.
regional_presence.China: ART operates a plant in Kunshan and an office in Shenzhen, enhancing its regional support and service capabilities.
